_comment: Store order, first panel first. The first three show in search results, so they carry the pitch: the offline vault, autofill, the generator. Slugs are the raw capture file names in listing/shots/raw/<device>/<slug>.png. App Store: up to 10 per device; Play: up to 8 per form factor.

status_bar._comment: add = the capture has no status bar (the flutter-test store renders in listing/shots/raw, which leave room for one); replace = paint a clean 9:41 bar over a real device's; keep = the capture already has a clean bar (simulator override / Android demo mode). The iphone and ipad folders hold test renders today: switch a folder to replace when you put real device captures in it.
